file_in_papers: Wu 2024 - Integrated Assessment of the Runoff and Heat Mitigation Effe.pdf
location: Kunimiga-Oka, Sendai, JP (46 ha residential catchment)
method: Single-layer canopy energy-balance model coupled with SWMM on 143 parcels; LAI and storage from Landsat NDVI; LAI scaled x0.8-1.4 and 7 greening patterns (evergreen street trees, denser street trees, courtyards, green roofs)
traits_or_metrics: Summer runoff volume, peak runoff, land surface temperature
key_quantified_results: Annual interception 13%; LAI x1.4: summer runoff -10.7%, peak -7.8%, mean LST -2.5 C; LAI x0.8: runoff +6%, LST +1.5 C; green roofs + denser street trees best; evergreen street trees weakest summer option
limits_noted: Surface temperature, not pedestrian UTCI; parcel-scale units; uniform air temperature; no species, no optimisation; humid temperate climate
relevance_to_topic: Quantifies heat + runoff together (scenarios), but no species traits and no optimisation: does not fill our gap
